description: cinatra#2024 (S9 program acceptance) — item A / design §3 / D2 only: the M1 governed-invoker (invokeConnectorInstanceTool / listConnectorInstanceTools) provider-scale + live proof PR #2189 (S4/#2019's scale-smoke fixture) explicitly deferred to program acceptance. Scoped to this evidence row alone, NOT the full S9 closing report (that is a separate, later item). Follows the S1 (#2016) capture pattern verbatim (schemaVersion + provenance + verdicts[]), with the codex r0 four-value vocabulary (PASS | PENDING_GATE | FAIL | WAIVED/BLOCKED-UPSTREAM) this program's design (§0 D1) adopted for exactly this kind of row.

detail.runsIn: normal root Vitest suite (pnpm test:root) — no live stack
detail.fixtureShape: 3 synthetic connector instances x 3 enrolled servers each (1 default triad-only + 1 dedicated scale server carrying 64 scalesmoke/note-get-NNN tools, matching docker/wordpress/scale-smoke-plugin's real naming + count, + 1 vendor server)
invariantsProven: no truncation across a paginated (pageSize=20) 64-tool listConnectorInstanceTools read
stable, revision-pinned ordering across two independent fully-paginated runs

per-instance isolation: a duplicate tool name filed onto instance-b's own second server produces the real ambiguous_tool resolution (never a silent misroute), while sibling instances A/C resolve the identical name unambiguously
report-never-drop: a duplicated name is never dropped from the governed list, only the invoke-by-name-alone path treats it as ambiguous
every acquire/gate call across the 3-instance matrix carries exactly its own instanceId (ledger-checked, not just gate-enforced)

9 CONCURRENT invokeConnectorInstanceTool calls spanning the full 3-instance x 3-server matrix resolve to their own pinned instance+server with zero cross-attribution and zero drops (set-equality checked against the real wire-call ledger, not assumed from call order)

localRun.environment: local (operator box) — no live WordPress fixture required for this half

detail.reason: self-skips without WP_BASE_URL + WP_MCP_BASIC_AUTH — this operator box cannot boot the cinatra dev/verify stack or any docker-compose db/redis band (workspace guardrail); the real round-trip only executes on a CI runner against a booted fixture.
detail.wiredInto: .github/workflows/trusted-read-scale-smoke.yml (new step added alongside the existing M2 live-proof step; reuses the same already-booted scale-smoke-plugin fixture and minted app password, no extra boot cost)
reusesRealProductionWireLayer: callConnectorInstanceMcpTool (connector-instance-mcp-transport.ts) — the exact function register-host-connector-services.ts binds in production
createConnectorInstanceSnapshotLoader (connector-instance-snapshot-loader.ts) — the exact per-server snapshot loader prod binds as loadServerSnapshot
whatItWillProveOnFirstCiRun: listConnectorInstanceTools, paginated through the real M1 dispatch, returns >= 64 uniquely-named real scale-smoke tools with no truncation, byte-identical to an independently-fetched raw tools/list
the pinned default adapter server is also reachable through the same real M1 dispatch (non-empty triad-expanded read)

9 concurrent real invokeConnectorInstanceTool calls round-trip the real PHP execute path and attribute each response to its own requested ability (id/note keyed to the ability's own numeric suffix) — no cross-attribution under real concurrent wire calls
detail.note: this row records the row's PENDING status honestly rather than fabricating a run URL; the PR's own CI run of the extended trusted-read-scale-smoke.yml workflow is the first authoritative execution. Re-file this verdict as PASS/FAIL once that run completes and its URL is known — not this lane's job (a follow-up S9 evidence-file update, per D1's own re-cite-at-checkpoint discipline).
